name: CommitAttempt
documentation:
Internal state of one model commit attempt, from its loaded begin-state through ordered changes and completion.
 Instances used only as a handler read context leave the evaluation and completion portions empty.

methods.name: aliasResolutions
methods.documentation: Internal loading provenance, separate from the canonically keyed loaded Models.

methods.name: ancestorReads
methods.documentation: Returns the proof accompanying this context's ancestor selection, or {@code null} for direct targets.

methods.name: completionResult
methods.documentation: Returns this exact commit completion through its public no-value contract.

methods.name: create
methods.documentation: Creates a loaded begin-state for one resolved target set.

methods.name: createSingle
methods.documentation: Creates the allocation-minimal begin-state used by a direct single-model strategy.

methods.name: currentReadContext
methods.documentation: Returns this repository's active mutation read context, never an event-replay or escaped async context.

methods.name: ensureReadBoundary
methods.documentation: Establishes the namespace snapshot before exposing any additional transactional dependency.

methods.name: graphEntities
methods.documentation: Loaded and staged values visible to Graph reads at this attempt's boundary.

methods.name: overlayAliasSelections
methods.documentation: Keep durable lookup proof while rebinding reads to aliases changed by earlier local substeps.

methods.name: readAliasIds
methods.documentation: Returns consumed alias lookups, excluding assertion-only lookups for ACCEPT.

methods.name: readModelIds
methods.documentation: Reads needed to preserve this policy's evaluation: ACCEPT only reapplies its original steps.

methods.name: readRelationships
methods.documentation: Returns the relationship dependencies relevant to the policy; ACCEPT excludes assertion-only reads.

methods.name: readsDurableStateOnly
methods.documentation: Whether this independent operation excludes uncommitted message-batch overlays.

methods.name: requireNoAtomicCallback
methods.documentation: Internal guard before a public asynchronous mutation leaves its originating thread.

methods.name: resolveRead
methods.documentation: Resolves a read binding without weakening the exact identity contract of entity(String).

methods.name: retainFailedPreparationReads
methods.documentation: Retains only ordering evidence when evaluation rejects provisional state before producing an outcome.

methods.name: retainWriteOrigins
methods.documentation: Retains precommit stamps and deletion identities for graph reads in later substeps.

methods.name: trackGraph
methods.documentation: Attaches the same attempt provenance to a repository-created Graph without changing its snapshot.

methods.name: withAliasResolutions
methods.documentation: Retains the lookup names that resolved injected read-only targets, including unresolved aliases.

methods.name: withAncestorReads
methods.documentation: Retains identity-only proof used to resolve indirect injected Models at this context's pinned boundary.

methods.name: withDeferredBoundary
methods.documentation: Internal single-document loading provenance; copies share the same one-time verification.
